findings.title: Metric alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its required abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Accessing `Detector.detector_handler` for a detector whose type is `metric_alert_fire` will therefore raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler...`, rather than returning the previously usable no-op handler. Implement the required stateful interface or retain a concrete non-stateful handler until metric alerts support stateful evaluation.

findings.title: Stateful evaluate docstring still documents the old list return type
findings.body: The method now returns a dictionary keyed by `DetectorGroupKey`, but its docstring says it “returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`.” This gives implementers of the abstract handler contract incorrect API guidance and can lead to list-based implementations that fail when `process_detectors` calls `.values()`.
